parameters.name: --target
parameters.description: A target on the internet. Repeatable.

parameters.name: --internal-target
parameters.description: A target inside the own network, for example behind a tunnel. Repeatable.

parameters.name: --packets
parameters.description: Echo requests per target and run.

parameters.name: --timeout-ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait for a single answer.

parameters.name: --payload-bytes
parameters.description: Payload size of an echo request.

parameters.name: --source
parameters.description: Local address the measurement binds to.

parameters.name: --self-check
parameters.description: Only verify that the sensor is able to run.
